purpose._: Locked expanded Home 2026-09-06 (Zillow-shaped after Redfin cut). Full-bleed search. Stacked house carousels. Illustrated doors. No Atlas, map block, town ledger, or market essay on home.
purpose.job: Turn someone who typed a money query into a search they can act on. Search is the Stage action. Photographed house rails and Buy/Sell/Invest doors follow.
purpose.primaryAction: Search city, community, or address. See all homes opens the Field.
purpose.audience: A buyer or looker at the top of the funnel who does not yet know the towns. NOT a seller (they arrive on /sell).
questionsItMustAnswer: What is for sale here right now?
Can I buy, sell, or invest from here?
Where are the buyer and seller guides, and what do people ask first?

beats.text: The homepage opens with live inventory in the first viewport.
Search field that morphs into results. Navy on cream, no glass.
Buy / Sell as tabs with a sliding indicator on the house control.
A real Sell address field without waiting on JS.
House cards on the rail: price, address, beds/baths/sqft on the installed Card.
Search hero carries a live market or inventory signal, not only a photo bar.
Featured community cards carry sourced pulse figures.
Browse places with live town counts, not identical empty chips.

tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts homepage-v6 --builder claude-opus-5-5 --evaluator claude --url http://127.0.0.1:3341/ --shots <the 16 files below>. The grok CLI and the Cursor CLI are missing in this sandbox, so the judge is the chain's claude link (claude CLI, the sonnet alias pinned to claude-sonnet-5, subscription): three scorings of these shots in one call, recorded exactly as returned, no re-roll. The builder (the homepage-dial lane, claude-opus-5-5) is not the judge.

First viewport, scale 1, palette-quantized, against the homepage-dial tree's own next build + next start (2026-10-01, build b2). The mark this receipt is held to is the homepage's on the same ruler: 67 (claude-sonnet-5, receipt of 6abe416f7, 2026-09-24, states default/rails/dial-open/search-open/sell-tab/featured/places/places-resorts); the resorts run is now inside #featured-community, so places-resorts is replaced by places-new.

tasteReview.beats: Zillow's and Redfin's homepages show zero live inventory until a search is run; this page opens with '3,198 LISTED' plus a price-ladder scrubber and a '12 asks, low to high' distribution visible before any click — a real win on immediacy and data depth. It loses to Redfin's own search-result card on completeness: Redfin's cards always carry full address + beds/baths/sqft, where this page's rail thumbnails drop both.

defects.finding: Rail thumbnail cards show only price and a partial spec string ('$398,000 2bd · 1,072 sqft') — no street address, no bath count. Brief 5 requires price, address, beds/baths/sqft on the installed Card for rail items, and only the single enlarged card above the rail carries full data, not the rail itself.

defects.section: fixed circular Jax avatar, bottom-right of every section (desktop.png, places-desktop.png, rails-desktop.png, sell-tab-desktop.png)
defects.finding: A white-outlined circular mascot bubble sits in an identical fixed position on every section of the page — hero, dial, places, ledger — and reads as a live-chat widget (Intercom/Drift pattern), which TASTE.md names directly as a refused tell: agent-chat chrome on public.

defects.section: Resorts and planned communities list, mobile (featured-mobile375.png)
defects.finding: At 375px the horizontally-scrolled community list clips mid-word ('85 fo...' for Sunriver) instead of wrapping the label or hiding the truncated neighbor entirely — an orphaned label at 375px.

Only the top row (Easton) carries the plain-English share line '9% of the 211 in Bend'; the other five subdivisions show a bar and a bare count with no equivalent context sentence, so the figures don't read consistently explained row to row.
The sourcing line reads 'Oregon Data Share via MarketPulse' — an internal product name exposed to a visitor instead of plain language like 'MLS data, updated daily.'

tasteReview.verdict: This is a genuinely interactive homepage, not a wall-of-text template: a live-count hero, a morphing search panel that actually expands into towns/resorts/listings/photo (demoMatch true), and a price-ladder scrubber on the listing dial that no portal homepage runs. It beats Zillow/Redfin on immediacy but fails the brief itself — the rail cards that are supposed to carry price/address/beds/baths/sqft only carry price and a half-spec, so competitiveBriefPass is false — and the fixed Jax bubble reads as agent-chat chrome the canon explicitly refuses. Craft is otherwise disciplined (one radius, tabular numerals, sourced median figures), but the featured-community spotlight is the dullest section on the page: a photo-plus-stats block every resort site already runs.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: evaluatorModel grok-4.6 to claude-sonnet-5 (the chain's claude link; the grok links are missing in this sandbox) and shotsHash (the page was redesigned 2026-10-01: the search opens into a results surface, the shelves are listing dials, featured communities a spotlight, Browse places a towns mosaic and a new-construction ledger). Same-ruler mark: the homepage's 67 on claude-sonnet-5 (2026-09-24); the 2026-10-01 dial-only runs scored 59 and 58 and held. This tree scores 74.
